SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols base ON cb.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
WHERE base.qualname = 'Command'
  AND s.qualname LIKE '%Group'
  AND s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.class_ancestry ca
      WHERE ca.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
        AND ca.ancestor_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
        AND ca.depth = 1
    )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.call_edges ce
      WHERE ce.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
        AND ce.callee_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
        AND ce.caller_file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
        AND ce.callee_file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
        AND ce.direct_call_sites > 0
    )
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds methods in the Group class (symbol_id matching 'Group' qualname in src/click/core.py) that override a Command base method. It checks class_ancestry for depth=1 inheritance and uses call_edges to confirm a direct call from the Group method to the Command method with the same name, ensuring the override is explicit. __init__ is included as it counts as an override per the request.

SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols base ON cb.base_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
WHERE base.qualname = 'Command'
  AND s.qualname LIKE '%Group'
  AND s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.class_ancestry ca
      WHERE ca.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
        AND ca.ancestor_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
        AND ca.depth = 1
    )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.call_edges ce
      WHERE ce.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
        AND ce.callee_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
        AND ce.caller_file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
        AND ce.callee_file_id = 'src/click/core.py'
        AND ce.direct_call_sites > 0
    )
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY s.symbol_id
